judge.rationale: The candidate only wrote the Definition of Done (`.lore/dod.md`), a brief update to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, and an acceptance test file (`src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`), stopping before writing any actual implementation code. None of the production source files (`src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, `src/config.ts`, etc.) or required documentation/changelog updates were touched. Furthermore, the acceptance test casts `options` with `as HalServerOptions` to bypass TypeScript errors for the unimplemented `history` option, and the tests themselves fail at runtime because `list_conversations` is neither validated nor handled. This is an incomplete TDD setup phase with zero working implementation.
